result.summary: Replaces hardcoded extended key strings across multiple test files with the test framework's ExtendedKey helper classes. This follows up on the introduction of ExtendedPrivateKey and ExtendedPublicKey helpers in PR #35543.
result.problem: Multiple functional tests still rely on hardcoded extended key string literals instead of using the standardized test helper classes, leaving test setup inconsistent and more verbose.
evidence: PR description: "This PR is a follow-up of PR #35543. I've updated the tests that were still using hardcoded keys, and used the ExtendedKey classes instead."
result.scope_notes: Small mechanical cleanup across 10 test files.
result.card: This PR replaces hardcoded extended key strings across 10 functional test files with the ExtendedKey helper classes introduced in PR #35543. It resolves inconsistent test setup patterns and modernizes key handling in older tests. It is an internal test cleanup with no user-facing or consensus impact.

risk.why: A mistake in key generation helpers would cause test failures or false positives in functional tests.
